changes: Homepage period totals, trend, queue counts, carriers and recent orders share a repeatable-read, read-only transaction and database-clock timestamp.
The panel validates counts, money, currencies, unique rows, recent-order identifiers, queue totals and exact-cent weekly trend totals before rendering.
Order, stock, warehouse and support responses fail independently; invalid successful responses do not turn into reassuring zero values.
Refresh runs every 60 seconds while visible and on returning to the tab; one active load prevents overlapping requests. Event listeners and timers are removed on cleanup.
Late profile failures, authentication results and data responses cannot update an unmounted homepage.
Charts use the report's database timestamp rather than the browser's changing day; the panel distinguishes last check time from the sales snapshot time.

verification.sql: verify-management-report.cjs passed actual report/dashboard SQL with synthetic current-day TRY/EUR orders, exact-cent trend totals, queue totals, historical returns and archive exclusion. Repeatable-read/read-only transaction settings and reset were verified.
verification.handlers: verify-dashboard-refresh.cjs passed duplicate refresh prevention, independent failures, retry recovery, support-only grants, hidden-tab pause, focus/visibility refresh, cleanup, stale profile failure and unmount scenarios.
verification.contracts: verify-dashboard-data.cjs passed inconsistent totals, duplicate rows, unsafe amounts, missing fields, Istanbul midnight, real zero data and valid negative critical stock.
verification.markup: verify-dashboard-view.cjs passed actual homepage rendering with timestamps, seven-day snapshot-bound charts, separate currencies, failed sections, scoped cards and unauthenticated views. Browser layout remains unverified.
verification.admin_build: dashboard-admin-build-20261122-evening.log passed compilation, lint/types and all 53 static pages.

rollout: Publish API before panel because the validated homepage contract now requires generatedAt. No new migration.
limits: Separate real PostgreSQL writer connections were not available; isolation modes were checked in PGlite.
Real role accounts, browser layout and live totals remain to be checked after publication.
